title: Flow run
inspectorEmpty: Select a node to see its detail.
loadingDescription: Fetching the flow definition and the run detail.
loadFailed: The run could not be refreshed.
errorDescription: An error occurred while fetching the run. Try again.
support: If the problem continues, share the request ID with support.
noAccess: You do not have access to this run
noAccessDescription: Your role does not allow viewing the runs of this flow.
notFoundDescription: The run or the flow does not exist in this workspace.
missingIds: The flow or run identifier is missing.
workspaceDescription: Select a workspace to open the run view.
workspaceErrorDescription: Your workspaces could not be fetched. Try again.
workspaceDenied: You do not have permission to create workspaces.
noDefinitionDescription: No flow definition is available for this run.
reconnectingDescription: Saved statuses are shown while the connection is re-established.
unavailableDescription: Only saved statuses are shown. Reload the page to try again.
nodeDescription: Press Enter or Space to open the node detail.

cancel.title: Cancel run
cancel.description: This stops the running workflow in a controlled way. Activities in progress receive a cancellation signal.

retry.title: Retry run
retry.description: This starts a new run with the same flow version and the original trigger input. The original run does not change.

approve.title: Approve node
approve.description: Sends an approval signal to node {node}. The workflow continues after the approval gate.

reject.title: Reject node
reject.description: Sends a rejection signal to node {node}. The workflow follows its rejection path.

errors.403: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.429: Too many requests. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.server: The server could not complete the action.
